description: Ecommerce-focused helpdesk with a REST API for tickets and account data.
auth_notes: Private apps use an API key sent via HTTP Basic (email as username, key as password). Public apps must use OAuth2.
gate_detail: API keys are available on all Helpdesk plans, created by the account owner or admins in Settings > REST API. Plans are paid (Starter $40/mo) with a no-credit-card free trial; public apps also need Developer Portal partnership and app review.
api_scope: REST API to read and write helpdesk data programmatically; account-scoped, acting with the permissions of the key holder's user.
mcp_notes: No Gorgias-published MCP server appears in the provided sources.
blocker_detail: Requires a Gorgias helpdesk account on a paid plan or trial and an admin to create the key; public apps need review.

evidence.quote: To authenticate API requests, Gorgias uses HTTP Basic Authentication with three pieces of information: your base API URL, your email address, and an API key.
The account owner and admins can access the API credentials and create API keys
If you plan to build a public app you have to use OAuth2.
Sign up for our Developer Portal to start our partnership. This step is required only if you plan to build a Public app.
Start free trial No credit card required

uncertainties: Webhook and sandbox support are not stated in the sources.
Whether trial accounts can generate production API keys is not stated.
